route.objective: Prepare a solution/change-readiness handoff and an ITIL 4 practice-alignment assessment for the FreshFields scanner certificate rotation using the existing normalized BA, acceptance criteria, and test baseline without regenerating upstream artifacts.

not_selected.reason: The requirements baseline (R-01 through R-07) is already normalized and traceable in the supplied source.
Delivery work items (D-01 through D-07) are already agreed and decomposed for this decision point.
Acceptance criteria (AC-01 through AC-05) are already baselined and linked to requirements.
Test cases and test execution results (T-01 through T-06) already exist with explicit pass/not-run evidence.

stop_rules: Downstream skills must not promote Candidate, Target, or Unknown items to Confirmed or Approved states (specifically: R-02 10 October target date, R-03 rollout group composition, R-05 alert threshold, R-06 Sunday 02:00-04:00 production window, and R-07 Change Authority identity).
Preserve confirmed policy gates and constraints: SEC-12 requires device-bound mutual TLS certificates, and CHG-04 requires an approved production change record prior to deployment.
Do not invent CAB approval mandates, Change Authority assignments, fleet-wide rollback timings (T-06 remains NOT RUN), or architectural mechanisms not evidenced in the baseline.
route.expected_final_artifact: A combined solution change-readiness handoff package and ITIL 4 alignment assessment for the go/no-go pack, capturing evidenced readiness, operational risks, governance gaps (CHG-04 compliance), and unverified rollout/rollback timing without invented approvals.
